en.content: The primary and secondary valencies of cobalt respectively in are :

options.content: 2 and 8
2 and 6
3 and 5
3 and 6

en.explanation:
In Werner's theory the primary valency of the metal equals its oxidation state and the secondary valency equals its coordination number.

The complex ion is ; with x as the oxidation state of Co,

So the primary valency is 3: two chlorides are ionisable counter-ions, and the coordinated chloride satisfies one primary and one secondary valency at the same time.

Five and one are bonded to Co, so the secondary valency (coordination number) is 6.

Hence, the correct option is (D).

संकुल आयन है; Co की ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था x लेने पर,

अतः प्राथमिक संयोजकता 3 है : दो क्लोराइड आयननीय प्रतिआयन हैं, और उपसहसंयोजित क्लोराइड एक ही समय में एक प्राथमिक तथा एक द्वितीयक संयोजकता को संतुष्ट करता है।

अतः, सही विकल्प (D) है।

en.content: 'A' and 'B' formed in the following set of reactions are :
en.explanation:
In 3-(hydroxymethyl)phenol, the benzylic is an alcoholic group: it is protonated by HBr and replaced by bromide, giving 3-(bromomethyl)phenol as A. The phenolic is not replaced, because the aryl bond has partial double-bond character and an aryl cation does not form.

In 3-methoxyphenol, hot HBr cleaves the aryl methyl ether: attacks the protonated ether at the methyl carbon, so the bond breaks (not the aryl bond), giving and a second phenolic . B is benzene-1,3-diol (resorcinol).

Hence, the correct option is (C).

en.content:
Assertion A : Hydrolysis of an alkyl chloride is a slow reaction but in the presence of NaI, the rate of the hydrolysis increases.

Reason R : I is a good nucleophile as well as a good leaving group.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.content: A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is NOT the correct explanation of A

en.explanation:
Hydrolysis of an alkyl chloride is slow because is only a moderate leaving group and water is a weak nucleophile.

is large and highly polarisable, so it is a strong nucleophile and rapidly displaces chloride: .

is also an excellent leaving group (weakest C–X bond, weakest base among halides), so the alkyl iodide is hydrolysed much faster: .

The is regenerated and acts as a catalyst; this dual role, stated in R, is exactly why the rate increases in A.

Hence, the correct option is (C).

en.content: In the following given reaction, 'A' is
en.explanation:
from HBr adds to the terminal (Markovnikov), giving the tertiary carbocation attached to the cyclobutane ring.

A ring C–C bond migrates to this cationic carbon (ring expansion), relieving the strain of the four-membered ring. The cationic carbon becomes a cyclopentane ring carbon carrying both methyl groups, and the positive charge moves to the neighbouring ring carbon (secondary 2,2-dimethylcyclopentyl cation).

A 1,2-methyl shift from the adjacent carbon converts this secondary cation into the more stable tertiary 1,2-dimethylcyclopentyl cation.

attacks the tertiary carbon, giving 1-bromo-1,2-dimethylcyclopentane.

A further expansion to a six-membered ring does not occur, because the positive charge is now on a ring carbon and no ring bond lies next to an exocyclic cationic carbon.

Hence, the correct option is (B).

HBr से प्राप्त अंतस्थ पर जुड़ता है (मार्कोनिकोव नियम), जिससे साइक्लोब्यूटेन वलय से जुड़ा तृतीयक कार्बोकैटायन बनता है।

वलय का एक C–C आबंध इस धनावेशित कार्बन की ओर स्थानांतरित होता है (वलय विस्तार), जिससे चार-सदस्यीय वलय का विकृति तनाव कम होता है। धनावेशित कार्बन साइक्लोपेंटेन वलय का वह कार्बन बन जाता है जिस पर दोनों मेथिल समूह हैं, और धनावेश पड़ोसी वलय कार्बन पर चला जाता है (द्वितीयक 2,2-डाइमेथिलसाइक्लोपेंटिल धनायन)।

संलग्न कार्बन से 1,2-मेथिल विस्थापन द्वारा यह द्वितीयक धनायन अधिक स्थायी तृतीयक 1,2-डाइमेथिलसाइक्लोपेंटिल धनायन में बदल जाता है।

तृतीयक कार्बन पर आक्रमण करता है, जिससे 1-ब्रोमो-1,2-डाइमेथिलसाइक्लोपेंटेन बनता है।

छह-सदस्यीय वलय में आगे विस्तार नहीं होता, क्योंकि अब धनावेश वलय कार्बन पर है और वलय बाह्य धनावेशित कार्बन के निकट कोई वलय आबंध नहीं है।

अतः, सही विकल्प (B) है।

Compound (X) undergoes following sequence of reactions to give the Lactone (Y).

Compound (X) is :
en.explanation:
Lactone Y is 3-hydroxy-4,4-dimethyloxolan-2-one: the ring carbon is bonded to a carbon, then a carbon, then a carbon joined to the ring oxygen. It is the cyclic ester of 2,4-dihydroxy-3,3-dimethylbutanoic acid, .

X is 2-methylpropanal, . Its single -hydrogen lets KOH form the enolate, which adds to HCHO (crossed aldol) to give 3-hydroxy-2,2-dimethylpropanal:

Cyanide adds to the aldehyde to form the cyanohydrin; hydrolyses to , and the resulting 4-hydroxy acid closes to the five-membered lactone:

Compound (C) is the aldol product itself; having no -hydrogen, it would only undergo a crossed Cannizzaro reaction with HCHO and KOH, and the straight-chain aldehydes (B) and (D) cannot supply the gem-dimethyl carbon of Y.

Hence, the correct option is (A).

All four are resonance structures of ; each carries one positive and one negative charge, so stability depends on complete octets and on whether each charge sits next to a group that stabilises it.

In D every atom has a complete octet: the positive charge is on nitrogen as and the negative charge is on the carbon next to , where it is delocalised onto the carbonyl oxygen. D is the most stable.

In B the carbanion is next to the electron-withdrawing and the carbocation is next to the lone pair of , so both charges are stabilised, but the cationic carbon has only a sextet.

In A the carbocation is next to the electron-withdrawing and the carbanion is next to the lone pair of , so both charges are destabilised, and one carbon has only a sextet.

In C the positive charge is on the electronegative oxygen, which has only one bond and an incomplete octet, and the negative charge is next to ; C is the least stable.

Increasing order of stability: .

Hence, the correct option is (C).

en.explanation:

The secondary benzylic Cl gives a resonance-stabilised benzylic carbocation, and the tertiary Cl on the side chain gives a tertiary carbocation stabilised by hyperconjugation; both ionise and give AgCl.

The vinylic Cl and the aryl Cl are bonded to carbons; their C–Cl bonds have partial double-bond character through resonance, and vinyl or aryl cations are highly unstable, so these two Cl atoms do not react.

Each mole of the compound therefore gives 2 mol of AgCl.

, AgCl केवल उन C–Cl आबंधों से अवक्षेपित करता है जो आयनित होकर स्थायी कार्बोकैटायन ( प्रकार) बनाते हैं।

द्वितीयक बेन्जिलिक Cl अनुनाद-स्थायी बेन्जिलिक कार्बोकैटायन देता है, और पार्श्व श्रृंखला पर तृतीयक Cl अतिसंयुग्मन से स्थायी तृतीयक कार्बोकैटायन देता है; दोनों आयनित होकर AgCl देते हैं।

विनाइलिक Cl और ऐरिल Cl, कार्बनों से जुड़े हैं; अनुनाद के कारण इनके C–Cl आबंधों में आंशिक द्विआबंध गुण होता है, और विनाइल या ऐरिल धनायन अत्यंत अस्थायी होते हैं, इसलिए ये दोनों Cl परमाणु अभिक्रिया नहीं करते।

अतः यौगिक का प्रत्येक मोल 2 मोल AgCl देता है।

अतः, उत्तर 2 है।

Work done = PV

= 3 × 105 × 1600 × 10–6

= 480 J

Only 10% of heat is used in work done.

Change in internal energy = 0.9 × 4800 = 4320 J

en.content:
Given below are two statements :

Statement I : An elevator can go up or down with uniform speed when its weight is balanced with the tension of its cable.

Statement II : Force exerted by the floor of an elevator on the foot of a person standing on it is more than his/her weight when the elevator goes down with increasing speed.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Both Statement I and Statement II are true
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Statement I is true but Statement II is false

en.explanation:
Statement I: when the cable tension equals the weight of the elevator, the net force on it is zero, so its acceleration is zero and it can move up or down with uniform speed. Statement I is true.

Statement II: an elevator going down with increasing speed has a downward acceleration . For the person standing on the floor,

The floor pushes on the feet with a force less than the weight, so Statement II is false.

Hence, the correct option is (D).

कथन II: लिफ्ट के फर्श द्वारा उसमें खडे व्यक्ति के पैर पर लगने वाला बल उसके भार से अधिक हो जब लिफ्ट बढ़ती हुई चाल से नीचे की ओर जाती है.
